thread:
Carla: Heads up — onboarding sample app in README is causing auth + runtime confusion for a few new users. Found two quick bugs: the JS sample doesn't `await` the call, and the curl example uses `Api-Key:` instead of `Authorization: Bearer`.
Carla: Broken JS snippet in README (copy/pasted):
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY);
const resp = client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-1', messages: [] });
console.log(resp);
```
Carla: Broken curl: `curl -H "Api-Key: $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat` — returns 401 for users expecting Bearer semantics.
Matt: Oof. Link?
Carla: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/onboarding/sample-app/README.md (line ~42-78) :eyes:
Matt: I'll open a quick PR to fix JS await + curl header.
Li: Also noticed the Python example uses `os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY')` while the rest of the docs say `REDWOOD_API_KEY` — inconsistent env var names are causing confusion in the samples repo.
docs-bot: Automated sample lint: mismatch env var found in sources/onboarding/sample-app/python_example.py -> REDWOOD_KEY (expected REDWOOD_API_KEY). Flagged 2026-03-22 09:12 UTC.
Julian: I can take the JS snippet. Which constructor shape do we prefer in the example? `new RedwoodClient({ apiKey })` or `new RedwoodClient(apiKey)`? Want to keep it consistent with SDK quickstart.
Carla: Prefer `new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })` — mirrors the TS/JS SDK docs. Also add `await` for async.
Sam: I'll update the curl and add an explicit note that `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY` is required (and include an example for token rotation using `REDWOOD_ROTATED_TOKEN` env var).
Ben: Can we add a tiny smoke test in samples CI that runs the snippets (dry run) to catch missing `await` / wrong headers? A couple of unit smoke checks would prevent future copy/paste drift.
Matt: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — fixes JS await, normalizes env var names to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, and replaces `Api-Key:` with `Authorization: Bearer`. CC @eng-devex.
Carla: Nice, thanks. Can someone also add a small note in CONTRIBUTING.md about preferring `Authorization: Bearer` and running `samples/verify-snippets.sh` before merging?
Julian: Will add script and a README line in the samples repo today.
docs-bot: Docs site preview deployed for PR #789: https://docs.redwood.ai/pr-789 — smoke preview passed. :rocket:
Carla: Awesome — closing this thread once PR lands. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
